schemes.name: NFSA Ration Card
schemes.description: 5kg rice/wheat per person per month at subsidised rate (₹2-3/kg)
documents: Proof of residence (electricity bill / rent agreement)
Passport-size photo of head of family
schemes.apply_at: Nearest tehsil office or state food department portal

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: ₹1.2L–₹1.3L to build a pucca house + ₹12,000 for toilet for rural BPL families
schemes.apply_at: Gram Panchayat office or Block Development Office (BDO)

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.description: ₹5 Lakh per year free cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization for low-income families and seniors aged 70+
schemes.apply_at: Nearest empanelled hospital, Common Service Centre (CSC), or beneficiary.nha.gov.in

schemes.name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM)
schemes.description: ₹1,000–₹8,000/month scholarship for meritorious and economically backward West Bengal students based on the level of study
documents: Income certificate issued by a competent authority (below ₹2.5L/year)
Mark sheet of the last qualifying public examination
Admission receipt for the current course registration
First page of Bank passbook (showing IFSC code)

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.description: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 for BPL widows (integrated with West Bengal state top-up allowances)
documents: BPL card / Certified BPL family listing data
Age proof document (Birth certificate, Voter ID, or School certificate)
schemes.apply_at: Local Block Development Office (BDO) or Municipality/Corporation office

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Monthly social security pension of ₹1,000 for BPL senior citizens (includes Central baseline funds integrated with the West Bengal state top-up allowance)
documents: Valid BPL Ration Card / Certified BPL Listing ID
Official Age Proof Document (Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate)
Self-declaration Affidavit stating no other active pension is received
schemes.apply_at: Local Block Development Office (BDO), Municipality Office, or via the Duare Sarkar regional outreach camps

schemes.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Income support of ₹6,000/year distributed in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months directly via DBT to all landholding farmer families
documents: Updated Land Ownership Documents (Khatian / RoR / Land Revenue Records)
Aadhaar-linked Bank Account Passbook with IFSC code
Active Mobile Number for OTP Verification
schemes.apply_at: pmkisan.gov.in or nearest CSC centre or Patwari/Lekhpal office

schemes.name: NMMS Scholarship (National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship)
schemes.description: ₹12,000/year (₹1,000/month) stipend spanning Class 9 to Class 12 for meritorious students cleared via the state level MAT/SAT selection exams
documents: Parental Income Certificate issued by competent authority (BDO / SDO)
Class 7 official report card / marksheet (50% threshold for SC/ST)
Institutional verification certificate signed by Head of School
Student bank account passbook copy with explicit IFSC code
Caste / Disability certificate (if seeking reservation quota allocation)
schemes.apply_at: State education department portal or through your school

schemes.name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
schemes.description: K1: ₹1,000/year scholarship (age 13-18) | K2: ₹25,000 one-time grant (at 18) for unmarried girls in West Bengal
documents: Certificate attested by Gazetted Officer / MLA / Pradhan
schemes.apply_at: School or college office, or kanyashree.wb.gov.in
